canon: Praderas abiertas al este de Los Manaderos, donde la hierba dura más tiempo que en el núcleo del clan; hasta aquí siguen las manadas de Corredores de Cauce su migración y hasta aquí llevan los Serhu a sus múrgoles. Sin asentamiento fijo: se ocupa por temporadas.
fuentes: backend/src/scripts/worldCatalog.ts:180; docs/rpgtarkor/lore-mundo/regiones/llanuras-del-viento-rojo.md (Los Pastos de la Deriva, Pasto Solar, Gradias); hierba: decisión de la usuaria, 2026-10-25

prompt.sujeto: A vast, flat grassland plain that runs out to a far horizon, empty and wild. In the foreground, large rust-red boulders and loose red gravel lie close to the camera, and a faint dirt trail winds from beneath them into the distance.
prompt.proporcion: The plain is so wide that the far escarpment looks as thin as a finger held at arm's length.
prompt.cuerpo: In the middle distance the ground is covered in tufts of grass that shade from fresh green to straw gold, with patches of bare red earth between them and scattered dark, leafless thorny shrubs.
rasgos: On the far horizon on the right, a long escarpment of red sandstone cliffs and flat-topped mesas rises out of the haze, with lone buttes standing on the plain.
prompt.rasgosSecundarios: Every tuft of grass and every stone in the foreground shows fine detail, and the ground softens into haze with distance.
prompt.pose: A dry wind combs the grass and blows streaks of glowing dust across the plain.
prompt.entorno: A wide, high sky arches over the plain with long thin bands of cloud, and fine red dust hangs in the far air, thinning the distant shapes into soft layers.
prompt.luz: Low warm light rakes in from the left through a golden haze, filling the sky with amber light and setting the grass tips aglow.

momento:atardecer.luz: The sun sits huge and low on the horizon, turning the sky amber and rose, setting the grass tips aglow in warm orange and laying long soft shadows over the red earth.

momento:noche.luz: Stars glitter in a clear sky above the plain, a soft, even pearly glow washes over the grass tips and the shadows over the red earth are deep and cool.

estacion:primavera.cuerpo: It is covered in tall straw-yellow grass tinged with orange, with fresh green shoots at the base of the tufts, shallow flood water gleaming in the hollows between patches of red clay and a few low bushes of dense, deep green with small broad leaves.

estacion:verano.cuerpo: Brittle straw-yellow grass tinged with orange stands in thin tufts over wide patches of cracked bare red clay, with a few low bushes of dense, deep green with small broad leaves.

estacion:otono.cuerpo: Tall straw-yellow grass tinged with orange stands heavy with seed heads between patches of red clay, with low plants bearing ripe fruit among the tufts and a few low bushes of dense, deep green with small broad leaves.

estacion:invierno.cuerpo: Short, flattened straw-yellow grass tinged with orange lies thin over wide stretches of bare red clay, with a few low bushes of dense, deep green with small broad leaves.
estacion:invierno.pose: A cold dry wind combs the thin grass and carries thin streamers of red dust across the plain.

estacion:invierno+momento:noche.luz: Stars glitter in a clear sky above the plain, a soft, even pearly glow lies on the flattened grass tips and a thin frost glints over the red earth in deep cool shadows.

IMG-16 (perfil fotorreal): descrito por capas (primer plano, plano medio, horizonte); diseño de imagen, no canon

capas.corto: A vast flat grassland in daylight, seen at eye level, with no animals and no buildings. Low warm light from the left through a golden haze. In the foreground, large red-brown boulders and loose gravel with tufts of tall grass. In the middle distance, the plain is covered in tufts of grass shading from fresh green to straw gold, with patches of bare red earth and a few dark thorny shrubs. On the far right horizon, a long escarpment of flat-topped red sandstone mesas rises out of the haze. A wide sky with thin bands of cloud arches over everything.
capas.sujeto: A vast flat grassland plain seen at eye level, running out to a far horizon, empty and wild, with no single subject.
capas.luz: Low warm light from the left through a golden haze: the grass tips glow and the boulders are lit on their left side, with soft long shadows to the right.
capas.tamano: The boulders in the front are as big as a sitting man, the grass tufts reach his knee, and the mesas on the horizon look as thin as a finger held at arm's length.
capas.forma: A flat plain with gentle swells. On the left, a faint dirt track winds away between the tufts. On the right, a long escarpment of red sandstone with flat-topped mesas and lone buttes standing on the plain.
capas.entorno: In the foreground, red-brown boulders and gravel among grass. In the middle distance, grass tufts, bare earth and dark thorny shrubs. On the horizon, the pale red mesas fading into haze under a wide sky with thin bands of cloud.
capas.color: Grass from fresh green to straw gold, dry and dusty at the tips; rust-red boulders with pale lichen-like dust; red-brown bare earth; dark grey-green thorny shrubs; amber and pale blue sky.
capas.paleta: straw gold, rust red and pale green with one accent of amber haze
capas.notas: IMG-55, escrita por Claude a ciegas desde el canon. Sin sujeto único (lugar). Estación no indicada: elegida hierba verde-dorada de la ficha. Los rebaños de Corredores y los múrgoles del canon no se ponen (un solo sujeto, nada pequeño). 'Sin asentamiento fijo' = sin edificios. Duda: 'núcleo del clan' queda fuera de la imagen.
